_comment: The prepaid Anthropic Console credit the OpenClaw API key draws on. credit_usd is the credit available since 'since' (UTC): to top up later, add the new amount to credit_usd (one line) and leave 'since'; for a fresh credit period set both. The guard alerts at 50/75/90 percent (Grafana rules) and flips OpenClaw to subscription mode itself at fallback_percent.
